title: ShankWidthFunctionSample
description: A real sample of the deterministic width function w(u) = baseWidthMm * taper_ratio(u, widthTaper), for u in [0, 1). Documents backend/jewelmind/geometry/shank/builder.py::_section_wire()'s width term and the widthSamplesMm.headMm/bottomMm fields on generated component metadata. See docs/bible/19-shank/546-width-function-model.md.

baseMm.description: The unmodified JDL band.width value (mirrors baseHalfWidthMm*2 in builder.py).

u.description: Longitudinal parameter; 0/1 is the head, 0.5 is the bottom.

widthMm.description: baseMm * taper_ratio(u, {mode, bottomRatio}) — always exactly baseMm at u=0/u=1 regardless of mode.
